Ada (PM): ok team — want to sketch a lightweight decision canvas for the console observability work for next quarter. I think we need a crisp way to trade dashboards vs. tracing hooks vs. cost breakdown vs. error analytics.
Mike (Eng): +1. can we frame it around customer impact, engineering effort, and unit cost improvement?
Sara (Design): agree — UX matters. dashboards often get deprioritized because they look lower effort but they require good defaults and query ergonomics.
Jordan (SRE): for reliability, tracing hooks (sampling + long-tail traces) are high value. but they add ingestion cost.
Ada (PM): proposal: run a 2-week validation with 3 customers — measure: time-to-detect (incidents), token-cost delta, and satisfaction. if we can show >30% faster triage or >15% cost saving with caching/aggregation, we escalate.
Mike (Eng): implementation sketch: 1) dashboard templates (cost + error widgets) using existing metrics API, 2) tracing hooks: low-overhead tail-sampling + link to spans in UI, 3) cost breakdown: token-level attribution per-route, 4) error analytics: stack traces + grouping + suggested fixes.
Sara (Design): can we mock the dashboard landing and a compact trace view? I can put up Figma frames this week. need product acceptance criteria: what "good" looks like for each feature.
Ada (PM): acceptance ideas: dashboards — 3 prebuilt templates, onboarding flow < 3 clicks, default timeseries sampling at 1m. tracing hooks — sample rate toggle, quick link to affected request profile. cost breakdown — route-level token cost shown per-API-key. error analytics — automatic grouping + top-5 root causes.
Jordan (SRE): add non-functional SLOs: UI latency < 300ms for dashboard tiles, trace fetch < 500ms for common queries. Also retention / storage caps for private customers.
Mike (Eng): effort estimate (rough): dashboards 6 dev-weeks, tracing hooks 8 dev-weeks (plus infra), cost breakdown 4 dev-weeks, error analytics 5 dev-weeks. parallelize across 2 squads -> 10 weeks wall time.
Ada (PM): tradeoff canvas idea: put each feature on a 2D grid (customer impact vs. unit cost change) plus column for dev effort. let's capture known customer asks per feature. Jordan, can you gather 5 enterprise requests for trace + cost features?
Jordan (SRE): on it — pinging customers today. also will quantify current ingestion cost per 100k requests.
Sara (Design): I'll produce clickable mocks and a shortlist of UX experiments (onboarding modal, query shortcuts, anomaly-highlighting) — deliver by Thu.
Mike (Eng): we should run a perf micro-benchmark for trace sampling strategies (priority sampling, reservoir sampling). I can spin up a small harness.
Ada (PM): decision checkpoint: next Tues we meet with 3 solution architects to validate the canvas. If they prefer trace hooks + cost breakdown over dashboards, we pivot scope: keep dashboards as templates-only for MVP.
ObservabilityBot: Reminder — weekly roadmap sync Tue 10:00am.
Sara (Design): quick q — are we prioritizing hosted console first or also Dedicated/Private parity? impacts acceptance (esp. retention and HSM keys).
Ada (PM): start hosted console mocks first, but list Private parity constraints as blocking items for Enterprise sign-off.
Mike (Eng): noted. I'll add a short TODO list in the spec: infra quotas, sampling knobs, RBAC for cost views.
Ada (PM): thanks — I'll draft the canvas doc and a short customer test plan. posting draft by EOD Friday. reactions welcome :thumbsup:
